persistent_start.reason: Register-ScheduledTask changes Windows logon state and was not authorized for T04.

idempotent_start.detail: A second invocation on an already listening isolated port logged another listen and stayed running until the probe stopped it. start_local_inference.ps1 skips a listening port, and it was not executed because it also starts a public tunnel.

effects_when_confirmed: Unregister scheduled task 'NEXUS Local Inference' only if that task exists
Leave metatester64, Ollama, and any gateway process running
Do not read, print, rotate, or clear LocalBridge/.env
Do not change Render environment variables
